{{Vanilla|Sand}}
{{Infobox auto}}
'''Sand''' is a gravity-affected block found in deserts and on beaches. [[Matcha Flavoured]] lets it be made from [[gravel]] in a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], so players need not dig up deserts, and lets plants grow on it.

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
* Blasting gravel gives sand ({{Value|Sand|cook_time|station=Blast Furnace}}).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/sand.json}}</ref>
* A block of [[sandstone]] crafts back into 2 sand.
* Eight sand around an iron nugget make 8 red sand.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/red_sand_from_sand_and_iron.json}}</ref>

=== Other sources ===
{{Sources}}
Mined with a tool that has the [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] tool intrinsic, sand drops [[glass]] instead, increased by Fortune.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/sand.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==
{{Uses}}
* Fired in a [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]], sand becomes [[glass]]; blasted, it becomes [[quartz]].
* Sand and red sand support vegetation, so grass and flowers can be planted on them.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/supports_vegetation.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History
